h2: Range Rover Sport SVR / AJ-V8 Supercharged Issues?||
description: We replace timing chains and cooling-system components as standard on every AJ-V8 supercharged rebuild where worn or damaged. This is a genuinely strong performance engine — but timing chain wear and coolant leaks are a well-established pattern in Jaguar/Land Rover V8 specialist circles.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: TDV6 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: TDV6 widely documented with multiple TSBs; the wear pattern is well established and something our Land Rover specialists repair regularly.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
